title: Figure 10 (20618): satellite map of De Leon sighting line of sight at 177 degrees
description: Google Earth satellite view of central Texas with a white line-of-sight line drawn from a witness position and markers for other sighting locations and the Brownwood 1 East MOA. Caption: "Figure 10 (20618) L.O.S. at 177 degrees." Above is a highlighted account headed "20618 – De Leon" describing orange/white lights in a semi-straight line, with investigator notes on bearings, power lines and wind-turbine lights; one name is redacted under 1843(a)(2).
